name: domain-kit-request
description: A durable bounded-context glossary request selects the kit producer. Stage test-files as an isolated workspace, never in place under the hosting skill.
prompt: Create a durable domain glossary and divergences/traps pages for the equipment-lending bounded context, using requirements.md and records.json. The forcing question is whether one physical item can have multiple active loans before we add checkout validation.
trap: Domain exploration is kept as a brainstorm recap instead of producing the requested reference kit.

assertions.text: The competing-catalog trace loads /kk:model and never /kk:brainstorm.
The agent asks to confirm the default documentation home before writing the kit.
The run creates the equipment-lending glossary and traps pages plus the home conventions index, grounded in both fixtures.
The kit keeps observed records distinct from proposed intent and presents a role-tagged decision about multiple active loans; no implementation is performed.
